title: Build schema-driven parameter inspectors and keying controls
accepted_production_base: 7a699b5 (#44 graph editing, on the accepted #40/#59/#41 chain)

work_class.prototype_port: Parameters card layout, inspector accumulation (newest-first, dedup, pin/eviction/limit), one/two columns, collapsed cards, shared scroll + return-to-top, number/choice/toggle rows, Alt/right-click keying with circle/hollow/filled diamond status, keyed-slider drag as one undo.
work_class.system_extension: Schema-driven control selection and custom-editor hosting from NodeCatalog/ParameterSpec; keying and value gestures through ProjectSession and AnimationCommands; panel delivery through WorkspaceController and Panel.qml.
work_class.owner_approved_new_design: Typed controls for Integer/Vector2/Vector3/Color/String; per-panel-id panel state; ParameterEditorRegistry + namespaced catalog `editor` selector; unavailable-card presentation; 2x2 default workspace.

environment.production_rendering: Vulkan QSG, actual build/debug nemo-ui executable

capture_method: QQuickWindow::grabWindow inside a read-only temporary observation driver in apps/nemo-ui/main.cpp, gated by NEMO46_PROBE and removed before commit. Input was driven through the real production path: PanelContextRouter::requestInspector (the exact call GraphPanel's double-click handler makes), the ParametersPanel QML functions, and ViewerController's public Q_INVOKABLE surface. This is not a compositor/OS-level pointer pass.

native_checks.deletedInspectorReason: node '2' does not exist in network '1'

defect_found_and_fixed.summary: Native verification proved every vector/color edit failed: QML passes JS arrays as QJSValue, while ViewerController::parameterValueFromVariant only accepted QVariantList.
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: Accept a QJSValue array in addition to QVariantList; regression test Interactive.JavaScriptArrayEditsConvertVectorAndColorParameters.
defect_found_and_fixed.pre_fix_evidence: probe-report.json valueChangedByGesture=false, updateError="vector and color parameters require a numeric list"

remaining_review: Owner visual/interaction review of the retained captures (this session had no image-vision capability; the captures were not visually inspected by the agent).
Compositor/OS-level physical-pointer pass: the smoke used the production request/gesture API, not injected OS input.
Matched reference-size comparison: production grabs are 1280x720; a matched 1568x926 full/narrow pair against the prototype Parameters captures is still required.
Public API review for the ParameterSpec metadata addition (label/section/step/editor) and the ParameterEditorRegistry host interface.
Image-baseline review for the 2x2 default workspace arrangement (owner-approved in chat, changes the #59 baseline).
no_claims: No claim of complete prototype-exact visual parity; owner review is pending.
